sentences.draft: The time-domain transmitted signal is generated through the inverse discrete affine Fourier transform (IDAFT) applied to $\mathbf p_{qk}$, mathematically formulated as $\mathbf s_{qk}=\mathbf F_{\rm A}^{\mathsf H}\mathbf p_{qk}$ \cite{ding2026}, where $\mathbf F_{\rm A}$ denotes the discrete affine Fourier transform (DAFT) matrix, given by \begin{equation}\begin{gathered}[\mathbf F_{\rm A}]_{rt}=\frac{1}{\sqrt N}e^{-j2\pi(c_2r^2+rt/N+c_1t^2)},\\r,t=0,\ldots,N-1.\end{gathered}\label{eq:daft}\end{equation}
sentences.source_section: II，式(1)主句及其 where；式(2)的矩阵形式句及其 where
sentences.source_quote: The time-domain transmitted signal is generated through the inverse discrete affine Fourier transform (IDAFT) applied to $\mathbf x_k$, mathematically formulated as $s_k[n]=\frac{1}{\sqrt N}\sum_{m=0}^{N-1}x_k[m]e^{j2\pi(c_1n^2+c_2m^2+nm/N)}$, where $x_k[m]$ represents the $m$-th symbol of $\mathbf x_k$.

secondary_sources.quote: The signal in (1) can be represented in matrix form as $\mathbf s_k=\mathbf A^H\mathbf x_k=\mathbf\Lambda_{c_1}^H\mathbf F\mathbf\Lambda_{c_2}^H\mathbf x_k$, where $\mathbf A^H=\mathbf\Lambda_{c_1}^H\mathbf F\mathbf\Lambda_{c_2}^H$ represents the DAFT matrix.

secondary_sources.quote: The DAFT-domain symbol vector is mapped to the time domain via an $N$-point inverse IDAFT [14], which can be compactly expressed in matrix form as $\mathbf s=\mathbf A^H\mathbf x=\mathbf\Lambda_{c_1}^H\mathbf F^H\mathbf\Lambda_{c_2}^H\mathbf x$, where $\mathbf A$ denotes the DAFT matrix, $c_1$ and $c_2$ are the AFDM chirp-design parameters, $\mathbf\Lambda_c$ is a diagonal chirp-modulation matrix, and $\mathbf F$ is the unitary $N$-point DFT matrix.
